subject.title: feat(codex): allow configured app-server provider ids

question: Should OpenClaw accept `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.providerIds` as the supported way to route custom Codex `model_providers` through the bundled app-server harness?
rationale: This is a new advanced config/default surface in provider routing; the parser bug is mechanical, but whether this knob should exist is a maintainer product/config-boundary choice.

options.title: Accept With Parser Fix
options.body: Keep the advanced field only after `supports()` uses the strict Codex config parser and regression tests cover malformed `appServer` blocks.

options.title: Use Existing Provider Policy
options.body: Decline the new field and require users to stay on existing `openai/*`, `codex/*`, or provider/model runtime policy paths.

options.title: Defer Custom Provider Design
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers decide a broader mapping between OpenClaw providers and Codex `model_providers`.

recommendation.title: Accept With Parser Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the advanced field only after `supports()` uses the strict Codex config parser and regression tests cover malformed `appServer` blocks.

likelyOwner.reason: The original app-server harness and controls history is the closest product/config-boundary ownership signal for this new option.
